units: USD millions except shares, dates, multipliers and percentages
classification: Analyst cash estimate, not a reported September balance sheet
burn_method: Prorate H1 reported operating cash use plus cash capex over 181 days to the 72 days after June 30. Add a separate prorated finance-lease principal outflow. This is a historical-rate estimate, not Q3 guidance or FCFF.
lease_locator: Page 8; finance lease principal payments; six months ended June 30 2026; USD thousands 149 divided by 1000
reserve_basis: Provisional analyst buffer, approximately 2.6 months of H1 cash operating expense proxy (COGS + R&D + SG&A - D&A - SBC). Excludes working-capital swings, capex and acquisition funding; test 100 to 300. Not a company requirement or dividend capacity.
securities_basis: Carry June fair value, assuming no net portfolio movement or value change; marketable investments are separately disclosed from cash. Stress 2% haircut. Not a claimed September quote.
atm_basis: Zero additional credit in the reference case because completed proceeds by cutoff are unverified. This does not assert zero actual sales. Separate hypothetical 50%/100% authorized issuance cases pair net cash with shares at the selected price.
atm_other_expenses_note: Commission modeled at disclosed 2% maximum; other costs unquantified. Net proceeds scenarios before other costs are optimistic to that extent.
known_option_cash_policy: Include only the verified September 2 exercise receipt in this cash estimate. Remaining hypothetical option proceeds belong in the equity bridge separately, net of this receipt.
excluded_additions: Restricted cash: already outside the opening cash line; do not subtract it again
Future option exercise receipts other than the verified event
other_flow_assumptions: No separate new acquisition payment, other financing, disposal, FX change or change in restricted cash is estimated. Unknown movements remain an uncertainty, not a statement that none occurred. H1 CFO already includes interest, taxes and operating lease payments; do not add them again.
scope: Standalone liquidity estimate. Iridium closing and financing require a separate integrated transaction scenario; no assertion that these funds are distributable.
